series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): On an ordinary school afternoon, Takashi skips class on the outdoor staircase while Saya mocks him for slacking. Down below, an unsettling stranger repeatedly rams his body against the locked front gate. When physical education teachers confront the intruder, he savagely bites Mr. Hayashi through the iron bars. Within seconds of dying, the teacher reanimates into a bloodthirsty monster, tearing into his colleagues right before Takashi's eyes.
Prior events (Part 2): Takashi bursts into his classroom and pulls Rei and Hisashi away, insisting that an infected killer is loose on campus. While Rei dismisses his panic as jealousy, Hisashi trusts the terror in Takashi's eyes and arms them with makeshift weapons. Their escape is interrupted when the principal's emergency evacuation broadcast abruptly turns into horrific screams as staff are devoured live over the intercom, triggering an uncontrollable stampede in the corridors.
Prior events (Part 3): The school corridors become a slaughterhouse as the undead swarm the fleeing student body. Takashi, Hisashi, and Rei fight their way through the upper landing, striking down attackers with their makeshift weapons. When an infected lunges at Rei, Hisashi shields her body and takes the brunt of the assault against the railing. After Takashi clubs the monster away, the three manage to barricade themselves on the rooftop, unaware of the grim toll the clash took on Hisashi.
